title: 021 约会去了022 你真是渣男啊
slug: 从小欢喜开启诸天之旅
content_zh:
“舅舅，我们先走，别让杨杨看见了。”陆泽坐在副驾驶，将背包仍在后座，他朝着身边的刘铮说道：“我记得小姨去的那家医院是北大第一附属医院，舅舅你在那边有熟人没？”
关于小姨刘静的事情，季杨杨跟季胜利两个人显然不是适合商量的对象。
陆泽第一时间想到能商量的人就是舅舅刘铮。
而一向嬉皮笑脸的刘铮这时候表情看上去格外的严肃：“小泽，你确定你小姨真的生病了是吧？这种事情可不是随便说说的啊。”
“我在附属医院那边已经提前找了关系，估计过两天就能有消息。”
刘铮开着车快速驶离学校门口。
在刚开始接到这个外甥电话的时候他还以为是陆泽在学校遇到了什么麻烦，但是聊了几句才发现竟然是自己姐姐出了大问题。
而且话里话外的意思，这次的事情还挺严重。
刘铮知道陆泽并不是个没有主见的孩子，所以他对待这件事就极其的认真。
不怕一万，就怕万一。
毕竟他已经没了一個姐姐，他绝对不能接受最后的这个姐姐出哪怕一点点的问题。
窗外街景快速向后方驶过，落日的余晖洒落在道路旁的千头椿上面，可是陆泽没有心情转头去欣赏这美丽的画面。
他郑重道：“我可以肯定小姨百分百是生了病，而且还不想让我们知道。”
刘铮一边开车一边听着外甥的话，心却逐渐的沉了下去。
黑色奔驰车缓缓停在了一处广场外的停车场，刘铮把头埋进了方向盘，这位中年男人深吸一口气然后快速抬起头，脸上的疲惫清晰可见。
“小泽，舅舅要谢谢你。”
陆泽轻轻的拍了拍舅舅的肩膀：“行啦，万一没什么事呢？”
“再说啦，不管有什么病，早点治疗肯定是好的啊。”
“小姨她还有咱们呢。”
刘铮将心头的阴霾驱散，听着旁边这小子竟然说出如此老气横秋的话，他忍不住笑了出来：“你个臭小子开学以后就没给舅舅打过几次电话，这次倒好，一下子就给了我这么大的惊吓。”

陆泽连忙整理了一下被舅舅故意弄乱的发型。
“走吧走吧，趁着杨杨不在，咱俩进去好好搓一顿。”
“我们班女同学今天逮着我一顿猛薅羊毛，我也得在你这个土豪身上薅点羊毛。”
......
“妈，我回来了。”
“杨杨回来啦，饭马上就好，小泽杨杨伱们饿不饿？”刘静正围着围裙在厨房里忙活，她转过头才发现回来的只有儿子一个人，询问道：“杨杨，你哥哥呢？”
季杨杨换好拖鞋来到客厅，坐到沙发上给自己倒了杯水。
他没好气的说道：“我表哥？他啊，不知道跟谁约会去了呗。”
“啊？”
......
“阿嚏！”
陆泽已经连续打了好几个喷嚏，对坐的刘铮连忙给他又递上几张纸巾。
“小泽你是不是感冒了啊？从进来餐厅就一直打喷嚏。”
“阿嚏阿嚏，咳咳，你舅舅我好像也感冒了啊，阿阿阿阿...阿嚏！”
刘铮摸了摸鼻子，面色古怪。
不是有竞争对手暗地里烧香诅咒自己吧？
“阿嚏！”
......
陆泽回到书香雅苑的时候刚刚过七点一刻，这个时间段的小区还是比较热闹，来来往往能够看到许多遛弯的夫妻，还有穿着校服的春风中学学生打打闹闹。
感受着这种烟火气，他的心安静了下来。

小姨的事情有了舅舅这个大的靠山，陆泽心里的压力就没有那么大。
背着包慢悠悠的准备回家，陆泽看着身前不远处的一道身影有些眼熟，主要是这个标志性的花衬衫在小区路灯照射下看着有些显眼。
他顺势加快脚步走近一看。
好家伙。
content_en:
"Uncle, let's go first, don't let Yang Yang see it." Lu Ze was sitting in the passenger seat, leaving his backpack in the back seat. He said to Liu Zheng beside him: "I remember that the hospital my aunt went to is the First Affiliated Hospital of Peking University. Uncle, do you have any acquaintances there?"
Regarding the matter of aunt Liu Jing, Ji Yangyang and Ji Shengli were obviously not the right people to discuss.
Lu Ze immediately thought that the person who could negotiate was his uncle Liu Zheng.
Liu Zheng, who always had a playful smile, looked particularly serious at this time: "Oze, are you sure your aunt is really sick? This kind of thing is not something you just talk about casually."
"I have already made contacts at the affiliated hospital in advance, and I expect there will be news in two days."
Liu Zheng drove the car quickly away from the school gate.
When he first received the call from his nephew, he thought it was Lu Ze who was in trouble at school, but after talking for a while he realized that it was his sister who had a big problem.
And the implication behind the words is that this time the matter is quite serious.
Liu Zheng knew that Lu Ze was not a child without opinions, so he took this matter extremely seriously.
Don’t be afraid of ten thousand, just be afraid of what happens.
After all, he has lost a sister, and he absolutely cannot accept that the last sister has even the slightest problem.
The street scene outside the window was quickly passing behind, and the afterglow of the setting sun fell on the thousand-headed chrysanthemums beside the road, but Lu Ze was in no mood to turn around and appreciate this beautiful scene.
He solemnly said: "I am 100% sure that my aunt is sick, and she doesn't want us to know."
Liu Zheng listened to his nephew's words while driving, but his heart gradually sank.
The black Mercedes-Benz slowly stopped in a parking lot outside a square. Liu Zheng buried his head in the steering wheel. The middle-aged man took a deep breath and then quickly raised his head. The exhaustion on his face was clearly visible.
"Ozawa, uncle wants to thank you."
Lu Ze patted his uncle's shoulder gently: "Okay, what if nothing happens?"
"Besides, no matter what the disease is, it is definitely better to treat it as soon as possible."
"Auntie, she still has us."
Liu Zheng dispelled the gloom in his heart. Hearing that the boy next to him actually said such old-fashioned words, he couldn't help laughing: "You brat, you haven't called your uncle a few times since school started. It's good this time. You gave me such a big shock all at once."
Lu Ze quickly straightened his hair, which was deliberately messed up by his uncle.
"Let's go, let's go in and have a good time while Yang Yang is not here."
"The female classmates in our class caught me robbing me today, so I have to robbing you, a rich man, too."
...
"Mom, I'm back."
"Yang Yang is back. The meal will be ready soon. Are you hungry, Yang Yang?" Liu Jing was wearing an apron and working in the kitchen. When she turned around, she realized that only her son was back. She asked, "Yang Yang, where is your brother?"
Ji Yangyang changed into slippers and came to the living room, sat on the sofa and poured herself a glass of water.
He said angrily: "My cousin? He, I don't know who he is dating."
"Huh?"
...
"Ah sneeze!"
Lu Ze had sneezed several times in a row, and Liu Zheng, who was sitting across from him, quickly handed him a few more tissues.
"Ozawa, do you have a cold? You've been sneezing since you entered the restaurant."
"Ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, ah, cough.
Liu Zheng touched his nose and looked strange.
Isn’t it true that some competitors are secretly burning incense and cursing themselves?
"Ah sneeze!"
...
It was just after 7:15 when Lu Ze returned to Shuxiang Yayuan. The community was still quite lively at this time. Many couples walking around could be seen coming and going, as well as Chunfeng Middle School students wearing school uniforms having fun.
Feeling the smoke, his heart calmed down.
SmallWith his uncle as a big supporter for his aunt's affairs, Lu Ze's inner pressure was not so great.
Carrying his bag and slowly getting ready to go home, Lu Ze looked at a figure not far in front of him that looked familiar, mainly because the iconic floral shirt looked a little conspicuous under the street lights in the neighborhood.
He quickened his pace and took a closer look.
Good guy.
